meta.what: Trial of the Sekhemas helper: the legend's lines (Rooms, Boons, Afflictions) and each affliction and boon's rating (community guides, patch 0.5.x, compiled 2026-11-15 - not official).

boons.name: Garukhan's Favour
boons.line: First hit in each room is free

afflictions.name: Random affliction
afflictions.line: Can end the run: never take one

afflictions.name: Ghastly Scythe
afflictions.line: Any Honour lost ends the run

afflictions.name: Deceptive Mirror
afflictions.line: You may land in another room

afflictions.name: Chains of Binding
afflictions.line: A slow on hit; the safest pick

afflictions.name: Branded Balbalakh
afflictions.why: Shrines, Earned Honour and healing boons all stop working.

afflictions.name: Chiselled Stone
afflictions.why: Petrify on hit is deadly in boss fights.

afflictions.name: Corrosive Concoction
afflictions.why: Strips Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield.

afflictions.name: Deadly Snare
afflictions.why: Trap rooms become Honour sinks.

afflictions.name: Death Toll
afflictions.why: One delayed hit later; only matters for no-hit runs.

afflictions.name: Ghastly Scythe
afflictions.why: Any Honour lost ends the run.

afflictions.name: Glass Shard
afflictions.why: Your next boon becomes an affliction.

afflictions.name: Orb of Negation
afflictions.why: Turns off your Honour Resistance and Maximum Honour relics.

afflictions.name: Unassuming Brick
afflictions.why: Blocks Earned Honour, Urn and all merchant boons.

afflictions.name: Unquenched Thirst
afflictions.why: No Sacred Water: no shrines or merchant.

afflictions.name: Veiled Sight
afflictions.why: Rooms are hidden on the map: you plan blind.

afflictions.name: Black Smoke
afflictions.why: You see one room less ahead.

afflictions.name: Blunt Sword
afflictions.why: Longer fights mean more Honour lost, worst on boss floors.

afflictions.name: Chains of Binding
afflictions.why: A slow on hit; one of the safest picks.

afflictions.name: Costly Aid
afflictions.why: Each shrine adds a minor affliction.

afflictions.name: Dark Pit
afflictions.why: Double trap damage; only hurts in trap rooms.

afflictions.name: Deceptive Mirror
afflictions.why: Breaks route planning and avoidance of bad rooms.

afflictions.name: Dishonoured Tattoo
afflictions.why: Only bites when already in trouble.

afflictions.name: Exhausted Wells
afflictions.why: Chests give no Sacred Water; a small loss.

afflictions.name: Fiendish Wings
afflictions.why: Faster monsters mean more hits.

afflictions.name: Forgotten Traditions
afflictions.why: Halves your Honour Resistance relics.

afflictions.name: Gate Toll
afflictions.why: Lose Sacred Water each room; spend it first.

afflictions.name: Golden Smoke
afflictions.why: Rewards hidden on the map; room types still show.

afflictions.name: Haemorrhage
afflictions.why: No Honour healing until the next boss dies; bad only when low.

afflictions.name: Honed Claws
afflictions.why: More damage means more Honour lost per hit.

afflictions.name: Hungry Fangs
afflictions.why: Hits take 5% of Life, Mana and ES; players report deaths.

afflictions.name: Iron Manacles
afflictions.why: No Evasion; harmless without it.

afflictions.name: Leaking Waterskin
afflictions.why: Lose Sacred Water when hit; mild.

afflictions.name: Low Rivers
afflictions.why: 50% less Sacred Water; fine later in the run.

afflictions.name: Myriad Aspersions
afflictions.why: Each new affliction brings another one.

afflictions.name: Purple Smoke
afflictions.why: You can no longer see which rooms are afflicted.

afflictions.name: Rapid Quicksand
afflictions.why: Gauntlet and Escape rooms cost more Honour.

afflictions.name: Red Smoke
afflictions.why: You can't avoid Gauntlets by sight.

afflictions.name: Rusted Mallet
afflictions.why: Knockback can push you into hazards.

afflictions.name: Season of Famine
afflictions.why: Weakens the main way to buy defense boons.

afflictions.name: Sharpened Arrowhead
afflictions.why: No Armour; harmless if you wear none.

afflictions.name: Shattered Shield
afflictions.why: 50% less Energy Shield; hurts ES builds a lot.

afflictions.name: Spiked Exit
afflictions.why: 25 damage per room; matters only in no-hit runs.

afflictions.name: Spiked Shell
afflictions.why: Longer fights, harder bosses.

afflictions.name: Suspected Sympathiser
afflictions.why: Half the Honour healing; spend less on shrines.

afflictions.name: Tattered Blindfold
afflictions.why: Hard to read trap and escape rooms.

afflictions.name: Trade Tariff
afflictions.why: Merchant prices up 50%; fine late, costly early.

afflictions.name: Tradition's Demand
afflictions.why: The merchant shows one choice; avoid it early.

afflictions.name: Untouchable
afflictions.why: Cursed with Enfeeble: weaker fights.

afflictions.name: Weakened Flesh
afflictions.why: Smaller Honour pool for the whole run.

afflictions.name: Winter Drought
afflictions.why: Lose all Sacred Water at the floor's end: spend it first.

afflictions.name: Worn Sandals
afflictions.why: Guides call it a big difficulty spike for bosses and traps.

boons.name: Ahkeli's Guard
boons.why: Brief invulnerability after a hit: less Honour lost.

boons.name: All-Seeing Eye
boons.why: Full planning and cancels all smoke afflictions.

boons.name: Crystal Shard
boons.why: Your next affliction becomes a boon.

boons.name: Dekhara's Necklace
boons.why: Removes most future risk.

boons.name: Earned Honour
boons.why: Restores Honour on each room cleared.

boons.name: Garukhan's Favour
boons.why: Fewer Honour hits every room.

boons.name: Holy Water
boons.why: Makes every shrine pay twice.

boons.name: Imperial Seal
boons.why: Makes Gauntlets and trap damage mostly safe.

boons.name: Orbala's Leathers
boons.why: One extra life, weaker than the Cloak.

boons.name: Raincaller
boons.why: Double Sacred Water; best early.

boons.name: Reparations
boons.why: A little Sacred Water when hit.

boons.name: Sekhema's Cloak
boons.why: A full extra life.

boons.name: Adrenaline Vial
boons.why: Free refill before the boss.

boons.name: Assassin's Blade
boons.why: Short-lived: a few instant kills.

boons.name: Balbala's Gift
boons.why: Your next merchant buy is free.

boons.name: Black Pearl
boons.why: Cheap trap protection.

boons.name: Diverted River
boons.why: Double Sacred Water on this floor only.

boons.name: Enchanted Urn
boons.why: Helps hit the Honour Resistance cap.

boons.name: Flooding Rivers
boons.why: Run-long income.

boons.name: Fountain of Youth
boons.why: Extra healing from every shrine.

boons.name: Fright Mask
boons.why: Less Honour lost on every hit.

boons.name: Glowing Orb
boons.why: A panic button below 20% Life.

boons.name: Hare Foot
boons.why: Helps every room type and the final boss.

boons.name: Honoured Challenger
boons.why: Makes shrines stronger.

boons.name: Lustrous Lacquer
boons.why: Big defense gain, strongest for ES builds.

boons.name: Lustrous Pearl
boons.why: Slower traps; narrow use.

boons.name: Mirror of Fortune
boons.why: Duplicates your next key; loot only.

boons.name: Moment's Peace
boons.why: Invulnerable for a room; save it for near a boss.

boons.name: Orbala Statuette
boons.why: Bigger pool for the whole run.

boons.name: Ornate Dagger
boons.why: Shorter fights mean less Honour lost.

boons.name: Sanguine Vial
boons.why: Monsters have 30% less Life: faster kills.

boons.name: Silver Chalice
boons.why: Your next minor boon becomes a major one.

boons.name: Silver Tongue
boons.why: Top priority in a farm guide.

boons.name: Scrying Crystal
boons.why: See one more room ahead: better routes.

boons.name: Upward Path
boons.why: More Sacred Water each room, if you save it.

boons.name: Viscous Ichor
boons.why: Fewer hits taken.

boons.name: Chipped Dice
boons.why: Lets you reroll the merchant's shop.

boons.name: Sacred Mirror
boons.why: Duplicates keys; loot only.

rooms.name: Gauntlet
rooms.why: Most guides say avoid it. Dodge-rolls and Honour Resistance 75% help.

rooms.name: Boss room
rooms.why: No Honour recovery between floor 4 and Zarokh.
